new_existing_experiment: Lucy Xu's public 2022 thesis describes a five-day withdrawal arm in mouse SVZ whole-body partial reprogramming experiments.
blocking_input: An authoritative mapping of omitted RNA cell barcodes to animals, or complete prefilter RNA/LMO data from which that mapping can be reconstructed and checked.
design_timing_status: Five-day withdrawal verified at design level; exact omitted-animal identities and collection times remain unlinked.

minimum_author_input_alternatives.artifact: Complete library-plus-RNA-barcode to animal assignment table
minimum_author_input_alternatives.acceptance: The join is unique within library, reproduces the deposited included animals, preserves rejected and unassigned cells, and covers the omitted animals.

minimum_author_input_alternatives.artifact: Complete prefilter Seurat object or compatible RNA, LMO and cell-metadata matrices
minimum_author_input_alternatives.acceptance: Includes cells before the paper-specific 2Dox5 and BL6 exclusions. Public feature names without the omitted-cell columns are insufficient.

minimum_author_input_alternatives.artifact: Identified LMO or Undetermined FASTQ accession with read structure and sample sheet
minimum_author_input_alternatives.acceptance: Establish that the files contain the required multiplexing observations before downloading large sequencing files. Current GEX filenames alone do not establish this.

required_for_every_route: Confirm which named animals correspond to each thesis arm and whether the code label 2Dox5 indicates the same five-day endpoint for each animal.
Provide induction, final doxycycline removal and harvest dates/times, genotype, age, sex, and reasons for exclusion from the paper-specific object.
Confirm sharing and reuse permission for any newly supplied unpublished data.
reopen_rule: Reopen computation when a verified public or author-supplied artifact satisfies one assignment route plus timing and reuse requirements. Freeze support, contrasts and QC before reading newly available outcomes; record the existing thesis outcome exposure.
conditional_experimental_requirement: If no usable existing assignments or equivalent withdrawal observations can be recovered, this mouse-specific withdrawal question requires new observations. Human retinal persistence, identity, unusual-state calibration and function remain separate requirements assessed by the overall campaign.
